entries.title: Psalms 43:1
segments: ¶Vindicate me, O God, And plead my cause against an ungodly nation; Oh, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man!

entries.title: Psalms 43:2
segments: For You [are] the God of my strength; Why do You cast me off? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

entries.title: Psalms 43:3
segments: Oh, send out Your light and Your truth! Let them lead me; Let them bring me to Your holy hill And to Your tabernacle.

entries.title: Psalms 43:4
segments: Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God.

entries.title: Psalms 43:5
segments: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.
